title: headcount sync & interview loop prep scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for weekly headcount sync (Fri 10am) and interview-loop logistics for Senior Inference Engineer (SIE) and Staff SRE roles.
- Keep an informal running log of candidate statuses, debrief template, outstanding asks for hiring managers, and budget questions to raise with People Ops.

Agenda for headcount sync:
1) Quick status: open reqs and top-of-funnel metrics (30s per role)
2) Prioritization: which reqs to accelerate this quarter (SIE vs Staff SRE vs Applied ML)
3) Hiring runway: budget/commitments for next 6 months (ask finance: runway impact)
4) Interview bandwidth: confirm interviewer availability and rotate schedule
5) Blockers & actions (recruiter support, sourcing, compensation authority)

Open reqs (owner / status / notes):
- Senior Inference Engineer (owner: Jordan P) / on-site loop scheduled / candidates: 3 active (A,B,C).
  - Candidate A: on-site 2/24, strong systems + attention optimization background; ask: comp band?
  - Candidate B: excellent LLM infra design, weaker CUDA experience — pair with coding task?
  - Candidate C: relocation required, visa pending.
- Staff SRE (owner: Riley G) / loop in progress / candidates: 2 active (D,E).
  - Candidate D: ex-cloud infra, needs deeper prod-debug examples.
  - Candidate E: promo expectation high; discuss career ladder during debrief.
- Applied ML (owner: Maya R) / opening paused pending scope revision.

Interview loop / schedule notes:
- SIE loop (4 interviews): systems design (45m), coding (45m), LLM infra + quantization (45m), manager (30m).
- Add a short 20m experimental design / perf-tradeoffs discussion for candidates with research background.
- Keep standard debrief rubric (see below) and ask interviewers to fill rubrics in Greenhouse within 24h.
- Interviewer roster: Jordan, Riley, Sam K, Priya V (coding), Elena M (quantization).
- Backup interviewers: Avery, Devon (if Priya unavailable).

Debrief template (to paste in Greenhouse notes / Slack debrief):
- Summary (2–3 sentences): candidate core strengths + fit hypothesis.
- Signal: one clear technical signal (example: implemented cross-attention kernel optimizing memory/latency).
- Risk: one clear risk (example: limited team leadership experience).
- Role-specific rubric (scale 1–5): systems design, coding, LLM infra, collaboration, bias/infra safety awareness.
- Recommendation: Strong hire / Hire / Maybe / No hire + rationale.
- Compensation ask (if mentioned) and relocation/visa constraints.

Rubric guidance (quick):
- Systems design: 1 = can't decompose, 5 = owns large infra designs
- Coding: 1 = buggy / slow, 5 = clean, optimal, explains trade-offs
- LLM infra: 1 = little exposure, 5 = built production inference systems w/ quantization/KV caching
- Collaboration: 1 = poor, 5 = leads cross-team initiatives

Risks / blockers to escalate to People Ops / Finance:
- Comp bands: need approval for above-band offers for SIE top candidates (esp candidate A).
- Headcount freeze possibility in Q3 if revenue variance > 8% — raise now to get tentative pre-approval.
- Interviewer burnout: multiple loops this week; ask managers to trade coverage.

Sourcing notes / outreach templates (quick):
- LinkedIn InMail for SIE: highlight low-level performance work, kernel-level optimizations, cite our open benchmarks.
- Candidate referral ask: ping eng-all with short one-liner + hiring bonus note.

Prep questions for interviewers (reminder):
- Systems design: ask candidate to design a real-time decoder service that supports KV caching + fallback to smaller model when under load.
- Coding: a focused kernel-level optimization or concurrency problem; prefer Go/C++ pseudo.
- LLM infra: ask for quantization trade-offs and memory/speed equations — expect specific numbers.
- Behavioral: cross-team incident postmortem example + role in remediation.

Action items (owner / due):
- Jordan: confirm comp band ceiling for SIE candidates with Finance by Tue 2/25.
- Riley: finalize interviewer schedule and send calendar invites by EOD 2/21.
- Maya (Recruiter): chase visa timeline for Candidate C and update by 2/23.
- Avery: prepare short scorecard template and circulate to interviewers before 2/22.
- Sam K: draft coding question repo PR and link to GH by 2/24 (ref: GH PR #78).

Notes to self / heuristics:
- Prefer candidates who can trade memory/latency with clear benchmarks; examples trump general statements.
- Watch for reheated answers — ask follow-ups.
- If promotion expectations > 18 months, surface to People Ops early.

Follow-up items for headcount sync meeting:
- Bring a 1-slide heatmap: open reqs vs priority vs interview readiness.
- Ask for tentative approval for 1 stretch hire headcount for Q3 (Staff SRE) if comp approvals come through.

Open questions / items to research before sync:
- What is current committed hiring budget for ENG-PLATFORM for H2? (Finance contact: Leila)
- Any changes to our relocation policy in 2026? (People Ops doc link?)
- Can we pre-approve interviewers for multiday loops to avoid calendar churn?

Quick links and refs:
- Draft scorecard template: https://confluence.company/pages/scorecard-template
- Recent interview playbook (internal): JIRA-1234
- GH coding question PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rlhf/pull/78

End scratchpad — will tidy into a formal headcount-sync deck if priority confirmed.
